name: Barack Obama
bio: Barack Obama served as the 44th President of the United States from 2009 to 2017. He publishes an annual list of his favorite books each December.

name: Oprah Winfrey
role: media executive and talk show host
bio: Oprah Winfrey is a media executive and talk show host who built one of the most influential book clubs in the world. Her picks have launched dozens of books onto bestseller lists since 1996.

name: Warren Buffett
role: chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway
bio: Warren Buffett is the chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway and one of the most successful investors in history. He recommends books in Berkshire's annual shareholder letters.

name: Bill Gates
bio: Co-founder of Microsoft and one of the world's best-known philanthropists. He publishes detailed book reviews and annual reading lists on his blog, GatesNotes.

name: Elon Musk
bio: CEO of Tesla and SpaceX and founder of xAI. He has named the books that shaped his thinking in tweets and interviews over the years.

name: Satya Nadella
bio: CEO of Microsoft since 2014, credited with reviving its culture and cloud business. He has described the books behind his leadership approach in interviews and in his memoir Hit Refresh.

name: Sam Altman
bio: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI. Previously president of Y Combinator, where he ran the startup accelerator from 2014 to 2019.

name: Patrick Collison
bio: Co-founder and CEO of Stripe, the payments company he started with his brother John in 2010. Previously founded the auction software company Auctomatic.

name: Paul Graham
bio: Co-founder of Y Combinator and founder of the ecommerce company Viaweb. Writes the influential essays on startups, programming, and thinking published at paulgraham.com.

name: Reid Hoffman
bio: Co-founder of LinkedIn and partner at Greylock Partners. He hosts the Masters of Scale podcast and wrote The Startup of You and Blitzscaling.

name: Naval Ravikant
bio: Co-founder of AngelList and early investor in Twitter and Uber. His writing on wealth, leverage, and happiness is collected in The Almanack of Naval Ravikant.

name: Jensen Huang
bio: Co-founder and CEO of NVIDIA since 1993, leading it from graphics chips to the center of the AI era. He is the longest-serving CEO among major technology companies.

name: Demis Hassabis
role: Co-founder of DeepMind and Nobel laureate
bio: Co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, and 2024 Nobel laureate in Chemistry for the protein-structure work of AlphaFold. He researches artificial general intelligence and how to apply it to scientific discovery.

name: Tyler Cowen
bio: George Mason University economist and co-author of the blog Marginal Revolution, one of the most widely read economics blogs. He hosts the Conversations with Tyler podcast and writes on economics, culture, technology, and food.
